Human_Cultist_Bane_IronConsul
Iron Consul Jaxbock is a cultist of  Bane and one of  Gortash's bodyguards. She is on the top floor of Wyrm's Rock Fortress at X: -25 Y: 206.
“
You may be permitted here. But I will not welcome you.
„
— Jaxbock

Involvement

If Jaxbock is killed before Gortash retreats to his office, she is replaced by  Black Gauntlet Stijin.
